title: intended offsets, hard sync only where designated, tails preserved

expect.c_default: intent on_picture, intended_offset_s 0.01; planned (no placement): sfx_onset_s 9.97 (10.0 + 0.01 - 0.04), acoustic_peak_s 10.01, measured_offset_s 0.01; no issue
expect.c_anticipate: intent anticipate, intended -0.25; sfx_onset_s 19.25 (20 - 0.25 - 0.5), acoustic_peak_s 19.75 = picture - 0.25: it matches its OWN target, so no issue (an intentional lead is recorded, not rejected)
expect.c_sync_bad: synchronous, intended 0, placed_onset_s 30.1: acoustic_peak_s 30.12, deviation +0.12 s against tolerance 0.0167 s -> sync-off-target ERROR (hard sync only because the cue designates it)
expect.c_trail: trail, intended +0.3, placed 40.3 with peak 0.1: acoustic_peak_s 40.4, measured_offset_s 0.4, deviation 0.1 s over the 2-frame tolerance (0.0667 s) -> offset-drift WARNING (never an error: the cue is not synchronous)
expect.c_drift: trail, intended +0.1, placed 10.2, peak 0.05 -> acoustic 10.25, measured_offset 0.25, deviation 0.15 -> offset-drift warning
expect.tails: music is cut 1.1 s before its audible end -> tail-cut ERROR; music-fade (declared ends_with fade) passes; vo-3 passes; a clip that rings past film_s 60 without a declared end -> tail-past-film warning
